name: subsurface check
//: The scene document, with the two version fields every serialized
document carries (ADR 0044): `version` is the format's schema version
and `abi` is the ABI revision the vocabulary is written against.
Both may be omitted — files from before versioning read as this
build's — and a file pinning a *newer* one is refused by name.
The material's graph pins `wxsl_subsurface`, which asks the pipeline
for the subsurface feature channel. `scene_check` checks the scene
against a setup without it and shows the refusal, then again with it.
